m01:room.title: The Sampling Office
m01:room.job: Settle what confirmed share the register can put on the record.

m02:room.title: The Check Timing Office
m02:room.job: Say how long a typical check takes, and where normal ends.

m03:room.title: The Scanner Trial Room
m03:room.job: Work out what the trial says about the scanner's error rate.

m04:room.title: The Queue Planning Office
m04:room.job: Turn the queue on the belt into a finish time for tonight.

m05:room.title: The Flag Sorting Room
m05:room.job: Find the share of records with at least one flag, and the share with none.

m06:room.title: The Mailback Office
m06:room.job: Say whether the East wing loses households more often than the rest.

m07:room.title: The Hand-Check Room
m07:room.job: Say what opening only a few batches would leave behind.

m08:room.title: The Front Hall
m08:room.job: Say how rare a 25-minute wait is.

m09:room.title: The Postcard Trial Office
m09:room.job: Say whether the postcard group's extra replies are more than chance would make.

m10:room.title: The Trial Review Room
m10:room.job: Test whether the scanner's lower error rate is more than chance.

m11:room.title: The Binder Repair Room
m11:room.job: Say whether missing pages and the flooded wing travel together.

m12:room.title: The Survey Office
m12:room.job: Put a range on the share of East wing households the register missed.

m13:room.title: The Field Crew Office
m13:room.job: Put a range on the mean time a door visit takes.

m14:room.title: The Block Count Office
m14:room.job: Say whether the register falls short of the people found at the doors.

m15:room.title: The Certification Chamber
m15:room.job: Say what the one block far above the line means for the seal.
